content:
Noah: Quick heads-up — onboarding Echo-2B on the 4xA10G pool is showing intermittent microburst p95 jumps. Running a full sweep but wanted to flag and get thoughts. :eyes:
Priya: Can you share the exact bench command and the prompt/sample set you used?
Noah: Yep — minimal repro I used:
```
./bench --model echo-2b --pool 4xA10G --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --warmup 200 --samples samples/echo_repro.json --repeat 3
```
BenchBot: job 86213 started by Noah · collecting 3 runs (id: job-86213)
BenchBot: job 86213 finished · summary: p50=48ms, p95=312ms (baseline p95=267ms, +17%), max spike=920ms, note: bursts occur ~every 200s
Eva: Do we have KV cache eviction events correlated with the spikes? Might be cache churn when concat lengths vary.
Noah: I grabbed profiler + logs. Key snippets: `kvcache_misses` jumps from ~5% steady to ~46% during spikes and batch sizes show sudden 3→12 jump.
Priya: Hm. Could be batching jitter causing big batches to form then time out. Can you try forcing `max_batch=8` and disable continuous batching to see if it stabilizes?
Noah: Running that next. Also trying a quantized variant to rule out kernel fallback.
Maria: I can try a quick A/B locally with q4_0 variant — if quant helps, that narrows it to kernel/attention path.
Henry: I ran a quick run earlier on q4_0 (single node, same pool) — p95 ~210ms and no 900ms spikes in a 10m window. Not identical infra but encouraging.
BenchBot: job 86220 (no-cont-batch, max_batch=8) finished · summary: p50=50ms, p95=275ms, max spike=310ms — much smaller tail but slightly higher steady p50.
Priya: Nice. That points to batching dynamics. Can we try: 1) tighten batching window, 2) cap batch size, 3) enable per-request TTL to prevent huge accumulated queues?
Noah: I'll schedule a 1-hour canary: route 10% traffic to `echo-2b:q4_0-canary` with `max_batch=8` and `batch_timeout=20ms` at 05:00 PST. Posting grafana link once up.
Noah: Action items:
• Noah — run canary and collect 1h of telemetry (p50/p95/p99, batch size hist, kvcache hits)
• Priya — help with hotfix config for max_batch and batch_timeout rollout
• Maria — run a longer q4_0 sweep on a staging pool and capture kernel fallback logs
• Henry — follow up if we see any regressions on steady-state latency after canary
Priya: Sounds good. If the canary is clean, we can rollout as a default config for Echo-2B on the 4xA10G pool and add a perf regression test to catch this. :thumbsup:
BenchBot: canary job 86231 scheduled at 05:00 PST · will post results in thread when complete.
Noah: Thanks all — posting the grafana panel here once uploaded: https://grafana.internal/r/echo2b/microburst (will be live with canary data) :rocket:
